summaryJa: FBIの鑑識スケッチ面接記録（2024年7月11日付）。被面接者（氏名は秘匿）は26 Federal Plaza（ニューヨーク）で特別捜査官およびOPU鑑識アーティストに面接された。被面接者は元米陸軍情報将校で、部隊の他4名とともにオフィスを出た際にチェイエンヌ山上空で未確認飛行現象（UAP）を目撃した。目撃時刻は午前11:25頃、天候は雲なし・低湿度・気温約50°Fの晴天。物体は「ジャガイモ型」で輪郭が明瞭、クリーミー〜白色のオパール状でやや半透明、わずかにきらめきがあった。表面は非対称・重なりのない不規則な魚の鱗状またはパネル状の構造で構成され、物体本体は静止していたが各パネルが異なる起点から同時にゆっくり波打つように動いた。約2分後に物体は消え（被面接者は“cloaked”と表現）、消失時に影は見られなかった。初期スケッチ草案が添付されており、鑑識アーティストが追加草案をSA経由で被面接者に送る予定と記載。
summaryEn: FBI forensic sketch interview record (dated July 11, 2024). The interviewee (name redacted) was interviewed at 26 Federal Plaza, New York, by a Special Agent and an OPU forensic artist. The interviewee, a former U.S. Army intelligence officer, along with four unit members, observed an Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon (UAP) over Cheyenne Mountain as they exited their office. Observation time about 11:25 AM; weather was clear (“blue bird” sky), low humidity, approximately 50°F. The object was described as potato-shaped with distinct edges, creamy/whitish opalescent in color, somewhat translucent with a slight shimmer. Its surface consisted of non-symmetrical, non-overlapping, irregular fish-scale– or panel-like elements; the overall object was perfectly still while individual panels shifted in slow waves starting from different points of origin simultaneously. After about two minutes the object vanished—the interviewee stated it “cloaked” in the time it took to turn their head—and no shadow was observed. An initial sketch draft is attached; the forensic artist will relay additional drafts through the SA to complete the final sketch.
